title: C4OS Grill Question 021A - Read Approval Boundary

questions.label: When you say allow all reads and previews, what boundary applies?
questions.help: Recommended: allow reads/previews inside trusted project folders and user-selected files, but ask for arbitrary outside-project filesystem reads. This preserves existing trust records while keeping previews ergonomic.
options: Allow trusted project reads and user-selected files; ask arbitrary outside-project reads
Allow all filesystem reads without asking
Allow all reads only after FS plugin is enabled

questions.label: Should previews follow the same boundary as reads?
questions.help: Recommended: yes. A preview is still content access, so it should follow the same trusted-root or user-selected file boundary.
options: Yes, previews follow the same boundary as reads
No, previews are stricter than reads

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify behavior for Browser URL reads, local file previews, screenshots, attachments, hidden files, or project files in missing/read-only projects.
